name: cities
title: Cities (commune and postal code)
description: One row per commune and per postal code, with its GPS point. The table to reference by a foreign key.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the row, never reused. It is the target of the foreign keys of an application.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Delivery label of La Poste for this postal code.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the GPS point, in decimal degrees (WGS 84).

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the GPS point, in decimal degrees (WGS 84).

fields.name: address_count
fields.description: Number of addresses of the Base Adresse Nationale used to compute the point. 0 when the point does not come from it.

fields.name: coordinate_source
fields.description: Origin of the point: ban, nominatim or commune_centre.

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: First day of validity of the row (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: Last day of validity of the row (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty while the row is valid: a row is never deleted, its validity is closed.

fields.name: replaced_by_city_id
fields.description: Identifier of the city that replaces this one once its validity is closed. Empty otherwise.
